command.text: Fresh session reopened persistent agent profile. Existing plan retained Robin (70), NB, 2026, CAD 14,000 cash / 74,000 TFSA / 155,000 RRSP, and five monthly categories totaling CAD 2,450. Annual budget arithmetic checks: 2,450 × 12 = 29,400 base; projected 2026 expenses CAD 26,950 reflect partial-year remaining months/closeout state and is not the full-year budget total. Salary screen has only public pension estimates; gross modeled 2026 income CAD 12,239 (OAS CAD 12,239, CPP/QPP CAD 0), no employer pension. No gross pension was entered as employment salary; prior lesson text mentions only an explicitly after-tax proxy concept, not a new input in this session. TFSA/RRSP room left unfilled because balances do not establish contribution room. Growth default 4.5% compounded monthly left after consideration; no debt, RRIF plan default retained. Existing January 2026 was already closed and its lesson persisted; did not create a new closeout or claim one. Month take-home overrides were not changed because the required employer pension amount/taxable net is unsupported; no unsupported tax claim made. A failed click on the hidden Skip to plan link and one export attempt from setup timed out; recovered through Save and finish later. Remaining untested: exact tax liability/credits, actual pension payment/tax withholding, contribution room, behavior beyond this profile, and mobile assistive technology. Browser errors command returned empty after recovery; command-level timeouts are logged.
